text:
maria: Nightly eval alert — prompt_set_A showed ~12% failures on redwood-open-v3-quant8 tonight. Validator reports malformed tool-call args. cc @ajay @sam

ajay: Which eval job / seed? can you paste a failing snippet?

maria: Job nc-2026-03-17-23:00, seed=20260317, prompt_id=pt-4321. Here's the assistant/tool output we see in the saved JSON:

```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"extract_entities","args":"{\"text\":\"Order 123: shipping to 1 Main St\"}"}}
```

maria: Notice args is a string (double-encoded) instead of an object — that's why our JSON schema validator fails with "args: should be object".

sam: ugh, double-encoding. That will trip the schema (we expect { text: ... }). Did any schema change recently? :eyes:  

nina: Is this happening only on quantized model builds or across the board?

maria: Only on redwood-open-v3-quant8 (v3q). Float16 v3-fp16 and hosted non-quantized are clean. Failures correlate with the continuous-batch kernel path on the quant nodes.

ajay: I think this rings a bell — when the runtime takes the fallback kernel path we accidentally stringify tool args in the low-level serializer. I'll try to reproduce locally.

sam: steps to reproduce for me to run?

ajay: Run locally with the eval harness:

```
./eval-runner --model redwood-open-v3-quant8 \
  --prompt-set prompt_set_A --seed 20260317 \
  --prompt pt-4321 --save-output /tmp/pt4321.json
```
Then inspect /tmp/pt4321.json for `tool_call` entries.

maria: Repro confirmed on my laptop with the same seed. Uploaded failing file: <https://drive.redwood/team/ml/pt4321-fail.json>

ci-bot: nightly-eval-bot: alert created -> Ticket ML-2312

ajay: Quick mitigation proposal: update the nightly validator to be tolerant — if `args` is a string, attempt JSON.parse before throwing a schema error. This prevents noisy alerts while we fix the runtime. I'll open a PR in evals.

sam: ok for short-term, but that masks the root cause. We still need runtime patch + test.

ajay: Agreed. Root cause: low-level serializer in the quant kernel path stringifies `tool_call.args`. Plan: (1) hotfix validator in evals (PR w/ tolerant parse), (2) runtime patch to preserve object shape, (3) add regression test to nightly harness, (4) roll out quant node update next Tue. I'll take ML-2312.

nina: Any customer-facing impact observed?

maria: None reported externally — only the nightly evals flagged this so far. Still want to move fast though.

ci-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/evals/pulls/842 (validator tolerant-parse). Deploy job started.

sam: Cool. Suppressing alert group on this failure class until the validator hotfix is live.

maria: Thanks team — removing pager for this alert. :white_check_mark:

ajay: I'll follow up with a short postmortem and add a unit test that asserts `tool_call.args` remains an object across kernel paths.

maria: Thx everyone. Closing the loop once runtime patch is merged.
